content: Vikram Patel from Omni Insurance Group called Rohan Deshmukh to discuss the expiration of his health policy (HP-2023-0456) on September 30, 2026. They discussed renewal options versus exploring a new plan. Rohan expressed a preference for keeping his current plan and avoiding a 5% rate increase. Vikram offered to lock in the current rate for a one-year renewal if payment is made within 7 days. Rohan requested that the renewal details be sent via email for him to consider.

action_items: Vikram Patel to email the renewal quote and form to Rohan Deshmukh
Rohan Deshmukh to review renewal details and consider payment within 7 days to lock the current rate
